findings: XAML explicitly makes the primary button default when DefaultButton is OK or Yes, resolving v13 uncertainty: default OK maps to primary Yes for YesNo dialogs. Existing delete-all-group warning overrides to No. Native keyboard behavior not executed.

Primary button IsCancel applies only to OK-only dialogs, No IsCancel applies to YesNo, and Cancel is always IsCancel but visible only for OKCancel/YesNoCancel. Hidden-button handling remains Avalonia runtime qualification.

Two Icon visibility Binding ConverterParameter strings include the literal suffix , Mode=OneWay} outside the x:Static markup extension, unlike other correct parameters. These look malformed; compiler/runtime acceptance remains untested, so no build failure claimed.
Outer Grid declares two rows but button Border specifies Grid.Row=2. Layout clamping behavior and rendered placement remain unqualified.
Secondary-message scrolling has explicit 160/272 height limits; wrapping controls horizontal scrollbar and padding. This is layout-source review, not rendered visual QA.
